subject: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

Hi Alice —

Great to meet briefly on the demo last week. Per our onboarding checklist, I’m your CS lead for the infra/security handoff. I’ve looped in Monica (implementation lead) and Ben (platform engineer) to start sequencing: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist entries, and the service-account pattern for API-based syncs.

To get us moving please confirm the following from your side:
- Primary SAML IdP contact for metadata exchange
- SCIM provisioning scope (users only vs users + groups)
- CIDR ranges we should expect to add to our egress allowlist and any proxy termination IPs
- Any org policies (2FA, session timeouts, automation account restrictions) that will affect role mapping

I’ve attached a quick checklist and SAML metadata stub for initial mapping. Proposed next step: 30-min technical kickoff on Tue (2026-07-28) 10:00–10:30 PT. Does that work?

Thanks,
Naomi
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-saml-metadata.xml (stub), scim-provisioning-schema-v2.pdf (guide)
From: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinCo IT <it@finco.com>
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

Naomi — thanks, this looks good. Tue 10:00 PT (1:00 ET) works for the kickoff.

Quick answers before the call:
- Primary IdP contact: me (I’ll send metadata, but our IdP team also wants the ACS URL and entity ID; can you paste those?)
- SCIM: users + basic groups (no nested groups) — we’ll supply a schema mapping doc after kickoff
- IP ranges: we have two egress NAT ranges (34.72.128.0/20, 35.201.64.0/20) and an outbound proxy at 10.10.12.5 (internal). Our security team prefers allowlisting by FQDN if possible; otherwise we’ll provide static IPs.
- Org policies: enforced MFA via hardware tokens for admins; automated accounts must be readonly by default.

Also, procurement asked for a technical contact to attach to the contract for inventory and billing purposes — can you include Ben?

—Alice
Director, IT Integrations
FinCo
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@finco.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

Hi Alice — thanks for the details. A few notes from the platform side before the kickoff:

1) SAML endpoints (for exchange) — ACS and SP entity ID:
- Assertion Consumer Service (ACS): https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs/finco
- SP Entity ID: urn:redwood:sp:finco:2026

2) SCIM provisioning
- We support SCIM 2.0; users + groups mapping is straightforward. Out-of-band attribute mapping: email, displayName, externalId, role. I’ve attached the full schema doc.

3) Service account pattern
- For scheduled provisioning and audit-safe automation we recommend using a scoped service account with key rotation via our KMS integration. We will create a read/write SCIM client with token TTL = 30d by default; request shorter TTL and we can set up automated rotation hooks.

4) IP allowlist / network
- We generally support both IP and FQDN-based allowlist (we maintain an egress endpoint behind a stable DNS record: api.redwood.ai). If you need static egress IPs we can reserve a small pool; I’ve attached a CSV draft for the ranges we’ll request.

I’ll be on the call Tue 10:00 PT. I’ll also share a short runbook during the meeting with the exact steps for metadata exchange, test user provisioning, and rollout gating.

Ben
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

Thanks for the quick kickoff everyone — good alignment. Follow-ups and action items from the call:

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Alice: Share final IdP metadata XML and attribute mapping (due 2026-07-30)
- Ben: Provide a service-account creation request template and policy notes (done — attached)
- Monica: Draft phased rollout plan (staging -> pilot -> production), include rollback steps and test cases (due 2026-08-03)
- Naomi: Coordinate procurement docs and finalize the mutual action plan (MAP) and kickoff signoff (due 2026-07-30)

Notes:
- Test user: please create a test user in a staging IdP group called redwood-onboard-test; we’ll attempt an initial SCIM push and report syncing results.
- Network: Alice, we heard that FQDN allowlist would be preferred. Ben will provide the DNS records used by our egress endpoints; if you must use static IPs, confirm and we’ll lock them.

Attachments: finco-mutation-action-plan.xlsx (MAP outline), finco-network-allowlist.csv (draft)

Naomi

Thanks — this is clear. A few procurement/security asks to close out before we flip to staging:
- Please provide the SOC2 cert and any runbook snippets showing audit logs for provisioning events (we’ll need that for our internal auditors).
- We need a diagram that shows the service-account auth flow and where keys are stored/rotated (KMS/HSM).
- For the MAP: can we add a blackout window clause for 9–11 PM ET on production push days?

I’ll share the IdP metadata and a staging test user by EOD. Procurement will confirm the billing contact once Ben is added to the contract.

—Alice

Subject: Re: FinCo: SSO/SCIM + IP allowlist & service account handoff

Alice — appreciate the checklist. Attached is a short diagram showing the service-account flow and KMS integration (we store keys in customer-bound KMS where available; otherwise we use our HSM-backed vault with per-tenant isolation).

I’ve also updated the MAP to include the requested blackout window for production pushes and added the test cases for user provisioning and group sync. Next steps from our side:
- We’ll validate your staging test user on Monday (2026-08-02) and push a single-user SCIM create to verify attribute mapping.
- If that looks good we’ll schedule a pilot with 20 users in the pilot org.

Thanks again — looking forward to a smooth rollout.

Monica
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
